public_research.plain_statement: It is false that: KM0: AND/OR gates of two earlier wires, each AND with an lf or 2 pf inputs (lf/pf: reads no line/point). If 3 lemmas: I no 4-cycle; C KM0, true on edges, false on <=1 line, no edge. Spot: input of a cone gate (below output, reads both). Live at p: a chain up has all AND lf inputs true at p. (p, w) served: a pf wire at a spot of a gate live at p is true at w only. Lines TL, points TP, cone ANDs KB live at 2 points, KP at <=1 (owners TP) cover them; #served + |TL| + #cone <= #lf gates + |KB| + #spots with a pf wire true at 1 line only + #cone-wire spots + 1.
